## Required

ROS 4.2.0 has six fields, five mandatory: trip/set identities, bait condition, species and percentage.

Dye colour is optional.

## Available

The 2025 review covers 67 trips (17 observer-monitored, 50 self-reporting) and 461 sets.

All 879 bait composition rows have type and percentage; 822 have a setting-condition reference.

Natural bait includes 820 defrosted records and one fresh record. No live condition occurs.

There are 49 artificial-squid records and nine plastic trap-line squid records.

## To decide

Agree species and condition mappings. Defrosted does not establish whole versus chopped; fresh does not establish dead.

Artificial bait is not a species: AR cannot populate the species field.

Resolve artificial, absent and unknown bait, plus aggregation where source categories share a target key.

The database allows settings without bait-detail rows. Reporting requirements remain open.
